title: Catapult: forms the way it launches
desc: Three versions of 822 S1 where the catapult construct forms along its own launch path, not from the ring, and the mob is launched along that path.

takes.name: arc traced back
takes.facts: throw arc draws backward from the landing ring to the mob's next block (6-18); arm and cradle form off its foot (18-28); release 44: the mob rides that arc

takes.name: arm sweep frame
takes.facts: arm appears at the top of its throw and sweeps down through it (12-24), leaving rails, struts and a stop beam; release 44: the arm whips back up

takes.name: rising launch rail
takes.facts: 40-degree launch rail rises from the ground under the mob along the launch axis (12-24); cradle rises in at its foot; release 44: it shoots up the rail
